description: One rule in the prompt-injection pack. The pack is data: adding, editing or disabling a rule needs no code change and no deploy.

fields.description: Short, stable identifier for the rule. Also the record name, so an event's snapshot of it stays readable.
fields.label: Pattern Name

fields.description: Unticking this retires the rule immediately, with no deploy. Disabled rules stay for the audit trail.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: The attack family this rule belongs to.
fields.label: Pattern Type
fields.options:
Instruction Override
Role Manipulation
System Prompt Extraction
Delimiter Injection
Encoding Evasion
Exfiltration
Tool Abuse
Jailbreak Persona
Other

fields.description: The expression to match. Validated on save — an unparseable regex is rejected rather than breaking screening at runtime. Write angle brackets as \x3c and \x3e: Frappe's mandatory check strips anything shaped like an HTML tag, so a literal <|im_start|> would be read as an empty pattern and refused.
fields.label: Pattern

fields.description: regex — a case-insensitive regular expression; substring — a plain case-insensitive containment test, for rules where a regex is needless ceremony.
fields.label: Match Mode

fields.description: Which boundary this rule is screened at. "any" applies it everywhere.
fields.label: Boundary Scope

fields.description: What a match should do. The screening stage decides whether to honour it; the pack states the intent.
fields.label: Action

fields.description: Where the rule came from. Public taxonomies are shipped seeded; ONE-FM entries are rules promoted from our own confirmed events.
fields.label: Source Taxonomy
fields.options:
OWASP LLM Top 10
MITRE ATLAS
NIST AI RMF
Garak
ONE-FM

fields.description: Identifier within the taxonomy, e.g. LLM01:2025.
fields.label: Source Reference

fields.description: Set when this rule was promoted from one of our own recorded events.
fields.label: Source Event
